description: Clean text the same way as the Remove line breaks page: join wrapped lines (optionally keeping paragraph breaks), tidy or strip whitespace, or drop duplicate lines (consecutive or anywhere). Optional trim, ignore-case and ignore-surrounding-spaces flags. Text is not stored.

join.description: For line_breaks: join with a space (default) or with nothing

trim_lines.description: Trim each line, default true for line_breaks and whitespace

whitespace.description: For whitespace: squeeze (default), spaces-tabs, or all

name: remove_line_breaks
title: Remove line breaks, whitespace, or duplicate lines
